decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed erection of a front extension and roof 
           to side elevation, because of its position, design and appearance 
           would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 
           number 79 Roxborough Avenue and is complimentary to the visual 
           amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of 
           the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in 
           accordance with the adopted UDP policies ENVB 1.1 (New 
           Development),  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and 
           Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the London 
           Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and 
           Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the roof and the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a front extension and roof to side elevation of existing house.
